en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street bordered by tall brick townhouses or institutional buildings with decorative facades. Two children stand on the sidewalk in the foreground, while a few adults walk further down the street. Gas-style street lamps line the road. The lower margin of the card is lightly faded with printed red captions identifying the location, plus a publisher line and a large handwritten signature.
